negative_reviews.author: Fay Dsilva
negative_reviews.text: Visited the metro centre branch yesterday. Waited to be seated within a reasonable time. Whilst trying to place our orders we had to wait for near 15 minutes, the staff who took our order looked extremely rushed and we felt they could have explained the dishes better and given recommendations as it was the first time we visited. The food arrived within 20 minutes. Taste and portion were decent enough. Tried a Ramen bowl, sushi rolls and a rice/chicken option. Had to wait quite a long time for someone to get the bill. It felt understaffed and slow in terms of service. The restaurant and the decor , ambience is nice. Would visit again.
